data.description:
OPERATOR PROPOSAL, 2026-08-05: "I feel like it'd probably be good just to take the workspace
directory... because we're often using worktrees and that is really annoying when that
happens."

TODAY `c11 launch-agent` resolves the child's cwd from the LAUNCHING SURFACE. Combined with a
worktree fleet, the default lands a new agent inside its parent's active branch — the single
most dangerous directory available (see the sibling guard ticket for the incident).

`--cwd <path>` already exists and is the correct explicit escape hatch. This ticket is about
the DEFAULT, which is what gets used when someone is moving fast.

PROPOSAL: a workspace carries a root directory, and `launch-agent` defaults the child's cwd
to it.

WHY THE WORKSPACE ROOT IS THE RIGHT DEFAULT, not merely a safer one:
  * It matches c11's own mental model — the skill already teaches "workspace ~= project,
    panes ~= concerns, surfaces ~= agents".
  * The project root is where `git worktree add` is RUN FROM, so a child that needs its own
    tree is already standing in the right place. Inheriting a sibling's worktree puts it in
    the one directory from which that is awkward.
  * It is stable across the parent's own movements. A parent that cd's around mid-session
    currently changes where its children are born, which nothing communicates to anyone.

BLOCKER / SCOPE: workspaces do not appear to carry a path today. `c11 list-workspaces`
returns names only:

    workspace:2  acetate
    workspace:3  acetate stems
    workspace:4  c11

So this is: add a root dir to the workspace model (settable at creation, editable after,
surfaced in `list-workspaces --json` and `identify --json`), then have `launch-agent` use it.

RESOLUTION ORDER, most specific wins:
    1. explicit --cwd
    2. workspace root, if set
    3. launching surface's cwd  (status quo fallback, so nothing breaks for workspaces
       that never set one)

Step 3 keeps this backwards-compatible: a workspace with no root behaves exactly as today.

NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR THE GUARD. A default cannot stop someone launching from inside a
worktree — it only changes where they usually land. The sibling ticket refuses the case that
must never happen quietly. These ship well together and neither makes the other redundant.
data.title: Workspaces carry a root directory, and launch-agent defaults to it

data.body: Implemented in 20594b96b / draft PR #407. Tagged runtime observed root in list-workspaces --json and identify --json, precedence through workspace_root, root creation/edit/clear, and rootless launching_surface fallback. Targeted c11-logic: 54 tests passed.

provenance.reason: Implementation committed, pushed, runtime-validated, and opened as draft PR #407.

data.body: Reviewed main...d7c21ef4c with C11-194's workspace-root model, persistence, CLI/socket exposure, and cwd precedence in scope. The background-caller precedence finding was resolved in d7c21ef4c. Root persistence is backward compatible, no-root fallback is preserved, and tagged runtime evidence covers creation/edit/clear and JSON exposure. No remaining findings. Verdict: approve.

provenance.reason: Inline review approved after d7c21ef4c; runtime and targeted logic evidence are attached.

data.body: Final-head validation at d7c21ef4c: list-workspaces --json and identify --json returned the set root; launch reported cwd_source=workspace_root; clearing restored cwd_source=launching_surface; new-workspace --root set both current_directory and root_directory. Tagged CLI returned PONG and the panes remained readable.

provenance.reason: Draft PR #407 is open at final validated head d7c21ef4c.

data.body: Final-head review of origin/main...500158c5a. C11-194 owns the shared AgentLaunchWorkingDirectoryResolver introduced in 20594b96b; precedence remains explicit --cwd > workspace root > launching surface. Root creation/edit/clear, persistence/backward compatibility, list-workspaces/identify JSON, and socket worker policy were reviewed. The later C11-193/C11-195 commits consume this resolver without moving ownership. No remaining C11-194 findings; approve.

data.body: Final-head validation at 500158c5a: narrow c11-logic suite passed (resolver, project-config positive/negative, existing-surface rule, worker policy, workspace-root persistence). A rooted linked-worktree workspace launched with exit 0, cwd_source=workspace_root, config_source=<root>/.c11/agents.json, warning[linked_worktree_cwd] on stderr plus warning_details in JSON, and child pwd exactly equal to reported cwd. Runtime artifacts are under /tmp/c11-launch-cwd-runtime.TPabjt/final-root.*.
